body_markdown:
***Ms. Beilby brings over 25 years’ experience delivering complex public sector capital programmes***


**LONDON** (14 September, 2026) — AECOM, the trusted global infrastructure leader, today announced it has appointed Jenny Beilby as Head of Building Surveying, UK&I. Ms. Beilby will be responsible for leading and growing AECOM’s building surveying team in the region, helping clients across a range of sectors maximise the value of existing assets and reduce capital expenditure


Ms. Beilby brings over 25 years’ experience delivering complex public sector capital programmes across justice, health, education, energy and leisure sectors. She joins AECOM from AtkinsRéalis where she was a director, leading a multi-disciplinary team of project managers, cost consultants, building surveyors and health & safety advisors on multi-million-pound projects through all RIBA stages.


“The built environment is facing complex, multi-faceted challenges” said Jo Streeten, Managing Director, Buildings & Places at AECOM. “From maintaining increasingly ageing assets during fragile economic conditions, to the increased threat of extreme heat and need to achieve Net Zero, our clients need an integrated, multi-disciplinary approach. Jenny’s strong technical expertise combined with her strategic leadership and client-centric mindset make her perfectly placed to lead and grow our building surveying team in the coming years. I am delighted to welcome her to AECOM.”


“I am thrilled to join AECOM at what is an exciting time for our growing Buildings & Places business,” said Jenny Beilby, Head of Building Surveying, UK&I at AECOM. “Building and nurturing strong and enduring client relationships across a range of sectors is crucial to delivering high-value programmes in operationally complex environments. What I am most excited about is leveraging AECOM’s global breadth of built environment expertise to ensure our client’s assets are safe, sustainable and cost-effective throughout their entire life cycle.”


AECOM’s building surveying team serves key clients across aviation, energy, defence, commercial real estate, education and central government including: Department for Education, Defence Infrastructure Organisation, Houses of Parliament, Manchester Airport Group, National Grid and Natwest.


AECOM’s Buildings & Places (B&P) division in the UK and Ireland brings together architecture, engineering, planning, masterplanning and programme management to help clients create better buildings and places. It serves clients across central government, local authorities, universities, healthcare organisations, property developers, investors, occupiers and major private-sector companies.


*Jenny Beilby, Head of Building Surveying for UK & Ireland, AECOM*


**About AECOM**


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at[aecom.com](https://aecom.com/) .
